proposal.hypothesis: The accepted right-degraded trace begins diverging while the fixed wall-clock cross-fade is still increasing locomotion authority: action saturation and angular speed rise at roughly 75% blend, yet the Supervisor continues to 100% and meets the redirect-to-traverse command edge on the next step. Integrating authority only while measured height, tilt, angular speed, and foot support remain safe—and continuously backing off when they do not—should make recovery-to-locomotion a closed-loop transition instead of a timer.
proposal.expectedEffect: Eliminate post-recovery relapse in the degraded Cases without weakening the Mission Judge, while preserving complete phase progression and ordinary locomotion regressions.
